title.zh: Trump administration weighs a global stablecoin plan to cement dollar's dominance
title.en: Trump administration weighs a global stablecoin plan to cement dollar's dominance

current_state.zh: The Trump administration is reportedly considering joint ventures with private companies to promote dollar-backed stablecoins globally, aiming to reinforce the dollar's reserve status and demand for U.S. Treasuries, even as the IMF warns of capital-flight and monetary-control risks in emerging economies.
current_state.en: The Trump administration is reportedly considering joint ventures with private companies to promote dollar-backed stablecoins globally, aiming to reinforce the dollar's reserve status and demand for U.S. Treasuries, even as the IMF warns of capital-flight and monetary-control risks in emerging economies.
